name: @raven/docs
description: MyST sites for the Raven and The Stacks docs

scripts.build: (cd raven && BASE_URL=/raven myst build --html --strict) && (cd thestacks && BASE_URL=/thestacks myst build --html --strict)
scripts.live:thestacks:execute: cd thestacks && uv run --no-project --with jupyter-server --with ipykernel --with requests -- myst start --execute
